what: An impl placed between a '// SAFETY:' comment and its 'unsafe impl' (three files in blaze-mem, one in bstd) compiled and passed 'cargo check' and 'cargo test'; only 'cargo clippy' refused it (undocumented_unsafe_blocks, deny). And 'cargo clippy -p blaze-std-shim' stops in a dependency: blaze-ids fails clippy::manual_memcpy at crates/blaze-ids/src/many.rs:253 on origin/main, so a crate above it is linted only with --no-deps.
cause: the dev loop's check and test do not run clippy; a deny-level clippy error sits on main in blaze-ids
whys: a broken safety comment got past check and test
they do not run clippy's deny lints
the dev loop under cargo has no single command that is the gate's lint set
blaze check is the gate and lanes use cargo
class: a deny lint that only the gate runs is found late
prevention: the how-to for the cargo dev loop names 'cargo clippy -p <crate> --no-deps' beside check; state: not written
